title: Set up Copilot Studio dev sandbox
subtitle: From Instant Sandbox to Dataverse and a Copilot Studio trial agent.

steps.title: Create the Instant Sandbox
steps.evidence: Use a personal Microsoft account to join the Microsoft 365 Developer Program, choose Instant Sandbox, and record the new sandbox work account.

steps.title: Activate Developer Plan
steps.evidence: Use a Microsoft 365 Instant Sandbox, activate the Power Apps Developer Plan, verify Dataverse and start the Copilot Studio trial in the dedicated developer environment.

steps.title: Verify the developer environment
steps.evidence: Check the developer environment name, region and Dataverse provisioning before building, because the region cannot be changed later.

steps.title: Start the trial agent
steps.evidence: Use a Microsoft 365 Instant Sandbox, activate the Power Apps Developer Plan, verify Dataverse and start the Copilot Studio trial in the dedicated developer environment.
